verdict.rationale: The product's own site says it can "Add a start and end time to each word in the transcript," which is exactly the word-level timestamp capability the story asks for. Support rests on a single homepage line, though: the API docs in the pack do not show the request parameter or the JSON output shape for word timings. missing for 10: API reference documenting the word-timestamp parameter and per-word output schema, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get word-level timestamps so every word maps to its position in the recording

citations.quote: Add a start and end time to each word in the transcript.
